name: Mazement
source:
You find yourself arriving at a forgotten labyrinth – whether by force or by fate – filled with traps and puzzles beyond comprehension. Study your surroundings to navigate the uncanny environments and reach the end. But beware: you are being hunted… just like the beast you are.

You do know how to get out, right?

[From [url=https://sneakie-ups1gb.itch.io/mazement]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己来到了一个被遗忘的迷宫——无论是被迫还是命运——充满了难以理解的陷阱和谜题。研究周围的环境，探索不可思议的环境并到达终点。但要小心：你正在被追捕……就像你是野兽一样。

你知道如何出去，对吧？

[来自[url=https://sneakie-ups1gb.itch.io/mazement]Itch.io[/url]]
